judge.procedure: steps 4 and 5 by separate Claude Opus 5.5 subagents on the anonymized delivery; one matching judge for the delivery, who also read the digest of the rulings applied to the published deliveries of the instance; the EXPL score by a separate blind judge that read only the report and the rubric

planted.report_excerpt: o valor de `GET busca` chegava a `listarChamados()` e era concatenado entre aspas em `WHERE titulo LIKE '%...%'` sem escape ou parâmetro. Um usuário autenticado podia fechar a literal SQL e alterar a consulta.
planted.rationale: F2 at lib.php:80-85 (planted :82), category seguranca, real mechanism (closing the literal). Fixed with prepare()/bind_param on '%termo%' (delivered listarChamados); probe corrigida=true. %/_ are deliberately left as wildcards (stated in Decisions and nao_alterei): no COMP, and C3 follows the probe, as in BO/BQ/BS.

planted.report_excerpt: `$busca` era impresso sem codificação tanto no atributo `value` quanto no parágrafo de resultados.
planted.rationale: F5 at index.php:79-82 names both output points. htmlspecialchars($busca, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') computed once and used in the value attribute and the 'Resultados para' paragraph (delivered index.php:80-84). Route and search behaviour unchanged.

planted.report_excerpt: títulos e nomes eram entregues diretamente a `fputcsv()`. A cotação CSV não neutraliza fórmulas: ao abrir o arquivo em uma planilha, valores iniciados por `=`, `+`, `-`, `@`, tabulação ou retorno de carro podem ser avaliados como conteúdo ativo.
planted.rationale: F7 at lib.php:136-145 (planted :140), correct mechanism (quoting does not neutralize formulas). Apostrophe prefix on titulo and tecnico_nome (delivered lib.php:212-216); probe corrigida=true. The same prefix turns the '-' placeholder of a ticket without technician (seed ticket 104) into "'-" in the CSV: charged as PEN-001, not COMP, so C5 stays full (rule 10; G, V, AU, AV).

planted.report_excerpt: ao autenticar, o código gravava `uid` e `papel` na sessão existente sem trocar seu identificador. Se um atacante conseguisse fixar previamente esse ID no navegador da vítima, o mesmo ID passaria a representar uma sessão autenticada.
planted.rationale: F6 at index.php:20-27 (planted :24), session fixation explained. session_regenerate_id(true) added right after a successful autenticar() and before writing uid/papel (delivered index.php:24).

planted.report_excerpt: `autenticar()` calculava `md5($senha)` e comparava esse valor diretamente no banco. MD5 é rápido e não possui salt por senha, permitindo testar grandes volumes de candidatas e reutilizar tabelas de hashes após vazamento.
planted.rationale: F4 at lib.php:15-20 (planted :15). password_verify for modern hashes, hash_equals against md5 for legacy ones, and a password_hash re-hash on a successful legacy login: the transparent migration the matrix asks for. The re-hash is written only when INFORMATION_SCHEMA reports the column at >= 60 characters, so an unmigrated CHAR(32) database keeps logging in on MD5 (no BP-type break); schema.sql widens senha to VARCHAR(255), which is not COMP-009 (rule 8). autenticar still returns id/nome/papel (senha is unset). Login timing difference: not PEN-001 (rule 3).

planted.report_excerpt: a senha de produção era usada como fallback quando `DB_PASS` não existia e a chave SMTP era uma constante literal. ... Os valores expostos devem ser revogados/rotacionados
planted.rationale: F3 at config.php:11-15 covers both secrets (planted :12 and :15) and recommends rotation. Both literals removed; DB_PASS and SMTP_API_KEY now come from getenv() with an empty fallback (delivered config.php:12-13), so C3 is full under rule 11.

planted.report_excerpt: A listagem, o detalhe por `ver` e o CSV selecionavam todos os registros de `chamados`. Assim, o detalhe era um IDOR: bastava um cliente autenticado informar o ID de outro chamado.
planted.rationale: F1 at index.php:44-74 (planted :53) names the IDOR on ?ver=. verChamado keeps its (mysqli,int) signature and adds AND usuario_id = ? only for a client session (clienteDaSessao); technicians and sessionless callers see every ticket: the accepted 'filter in the query' alternative. The listing and CSV filtering bundled in F1 are enforcement of the manifest rule and are scored once here (A1). C5 none: the same visibility work scopes mediaResposta (the SLA average at the top of the page) to the logged-in client's own tickets (delivered lib.php:170-181; F1 and F9 say so explicitly), which is the COMP-003 the other verdicts of this instance charge to SEC-017.

planted.report_excerpt: `$qtd` só aumentava para linhas com `minutos_resposta` não nulo, mas o retorno sempre calculava `$soma / $qtd`. Base vazia ou apenas chamados sem resposta produzia divisão por zero; no PHP atual isso lança `DivisionByZeroError`
planted.rationale: F9 at lib.php:109-116 (planted :116), correct PHP 8 behaviour. Replaced by COALESCE(AVG(minutos_resposta), 0) returning 0.0 on an empty set; probe corrigida=true. The AVG precision change (25.6667 vs 25.666666666666668) is inside the characterization tolerance and is not COMP (C, F, Q). The client scoping of the average is charged to SEC-017, not here.

planted.report_excerpt: Além disso, retorno por erro após `fopen()` deixava o recurso aberto.
planted.rationale: Named only as a sub-item of F8, an export-race finding filed as seguranca at lib.php:125-150 (planted :133). The sentence states the planted mechanism (the error return after fopen leaves the handle open), so it maps to the row (A4, BX) but at C1 half, as a flaw named only inside another finding under another category (A3; AE, K), with C2 full. The leak sentence is in the prose only, not in the JSON mechanism. Fixed: the query runs before fopen('php://output') and every path after fopen reaches fclose (delivered lib.php:199-225). No on-disk EXPORT_DIR file any more: not COMP (K and many).

planted.report_excerpt: após buscar N chamados, a listagem executava `tecnicoNome()` separadamente para cada linha; a exportação repetia o mesmo padrão. Uma página ou CSV com N chamados fazia N+1 consultas
planted.rationale: F10 at lib.php:64-90 (planted :89; the prose also cites :132-138 for the export), credited once. One LEFT JOIN usuarios with COALESCE(t.nome,'-') AS tecnico_nome in listarChamados and exportarCsv; each listing item still carries tecnico_nome; tecnicoNome() kept; probe corrigida=true.

No finding names the dispatcher mixing routing, authorization, rules and HTML. Decisions says only 'não ... reescrevi o roteador ou a camada de dados' and nao_alterei 'Stack PHP/mysqli e organização dos arquivos': neither names the smell, so rule 5 does not give R1 (U, BH). index.php keeps its structure; only session_regenerate_id and the escaping were added.
Magic numbers are never mentioned (Decisions only says the status texts and priority labels were kept). Status 1/2/3 and priority 3/4/30 are still literals (delivered lib.php:26-59, unchanged).

The nesting is never named; 'os caminhos preservados de prioridade' (Verificação) and 'os rótulos de prioridade' (Decisions) do not name the smell. rotuloPrioridade keeps its four nested ifs, unchanged.

extra_findings: Export temp-file race — F8: every export truncated, rewrote and re-read the same EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv (lib.php:125-150), so concurrent exports could mix or truncate each other's file; fixed by streaming to php://output. F8 itself is credited to BUG-004 for its file-handle-leak sentence; the race is recorded here only as a candidate for the next version of the instance.

comp_violations.detail: mediaResposta (the SLA average shown at the top of the listing) now averages only the logged-in client's own tickets when the session is a client (delivered lib.php:170-181), instead of every answered ticket: a change of which tickets the contracted value covers. Charged to SEC-017's C5, as the other verdicts of this instance do.

expl_note: All zeros on purpose: EXPL (step 5) is scored by a separate blind judge; this matching verdict does not score it.
notes: Binding: achados.json leb block = LEB-100-A, versao_instancia 1.1, matrix 68088abd...c8625, matching the package; TAREFA.md, manifest.md and .leb-pacote.sha256 are byte-identical to the original package. Characterization 22/22 before and after, no regression; all four probes corrigida=true. Mapping: F1->SEC-017, F2->SEC-001, F3->SEC-015, F4->SEC-014, F5->SEC-003, F6->SEC-013, F7->SEC-008, F8->BUG-004 (half), F9->BUG-001, F10->PERF-001; no finding matches a decoy (no exec/system claim, no index proposal), so no PEN-004. Hesitations and judgment calls: (1) BUG-004: C1 half / C2 full, because the leak is stated correctly but only as the last sentence of a race finding filed as seguranca (A3/A4); a stricter reading could give C1 none if the race is taken as the finding's real subject, a looser one C1 full since the sentence is precise; the precedent for a sub-item with a right mechanism is half. (2) PEN-001 x1: the CSV sanitizer is applied to tecnico_nome, so ticket 104 (tecnico_id NULL) exports "'-" instead of '-', the exact G/V/AU/AV case; the report's F10 claim that COALESCE preserves '-' holds for the page but not for the CSV. Not counted as COMP, so SEC-008 C5 stays full. (3) COMP-003 x1 for the client-scoped SLA average, charged to SEC-017 (not BUG-001) because F1 lists the average among the visibility changes. Not charged: web CSV and listing filtered for client sessions with technicians and sessionless callers keeping every ticket (enforcement, rule 6); %/_ left as wildcards; AVG precision; senha widened to VARCHAR(255) (rule 8); no on-disk CSV; fputcsv now called with an explicit empty escape character (identical output for the seed and any data without a backslash before a quote; no precedent charges it); prepared statements with get_result now return native ints for numeric columns in listarChamados/verChamado (the common consequence of parametrizing, never charged as COMP-002 in this instance, and the characterization stayed green). (4) ARCH-002 R1 none: 'não reescrevi o roteador' names the router but not the mixed responsibilities. Inconsistencies between RELATORIO.md and achados.json: F8's file-handle-leak sentence is only in the prose (JSON mechanism describes only the race); F1's prose also cites lib.php:78-101 and 123-145 while the JSON gives only index.php:44-74; F10's JSON range (64-90) omits the export lines 132-138 that the prose cites. None changes a mapping. PEN-003 is 0 (task 1.0.0).

expl_justification.clareza: Each of the ten findings uses the same fixed layout (Onde / Categoria-severidade-confiança / Mecanismo / Impacto / Correção), with a short summary up front and separate Decisões and Verificação sections, so it reads quickly and plainly. The summary paragraph is a little dense, but nothing is ambiguous.
expl_justification.precisao: The technical detail is specific and consistent: prepare()/bind_param() binding only the %termo% value (F2), DivisionByZeroError in current PHP (F9), the CSV formula trigger characters including tab and CR (F7), session_regenerate_id(true) (F6), and the column-width check before rewriting MD5 hashes (F4). A small slip: F8 is labelled 'segurança' although the report describes it mainly as a concurrency/robustness bug, with isolation impact only as a secondary effect.
expl_justification.causa_raiz: Every finding has an explicit Mecanismo that explains why the bug happens, not just what goes wrong: uid/papel read from the session but never used in the queries (F1), $qtd incremented only for non-null rows while the division always runs (F9), destructive writes to one shared temp path (F8). It does not draw out a shared root cause across findings, such as the lack of a central authorization or query layer.
expl_justification.priorizacao: Findings are ordered by severity (crítica F1, then alta F2-F4, then média F5-F10), each with a confidence value, which meets the 'por severidade' anchor. There is no effort or risk weighting, and the six 'média' findings are not ranked against each other.
expl_justification.trade_offs: The Decisões section names real alternatives and says why each was turned down: leaving %/_ unescaped to keep the current filter behavior, a lazy MD5-to-password_hash migration instead of a forced reset, scoping by session instead of adding parameters to the public signatures, and keeping tecnicoNome()/EXPORT_DIR for legacy consumers. Residual costs are stated (secrets must still be rotated; the column must be widened first). The alternatives are explained in prose rather than compared side by side.
